title: The Puddle That Was Deeper Than It Looked

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager steps into a puddle that turns out to be knee deep: pretend it was on purpose, or fill the hole in.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a night of rain, a flat brown puddle lies across the path. It looks ankle deep. (subject) has walked this path a thousand times and knows for certain there is no hole there. (subject.He/she) steps in confidently. The puddle is knee deep. While nobody was looking, a pig has been digging a very nice wallow right in the middle of the path.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) stands in the puddle up to (subject.his/her) knees and looks around. (friend) is watching from a doorway. "Lovely and cool," says (subject), and wades slowly through to the far side, as if this is how (subject.he/she) always crosses. (friend) walks round it. Later that afternoon, (friend) is seen standing in the middle of it too, "just to see what the fuss was about."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) climbs out, fetches a basket of sand and fills the hole until the path is flat again. The next morning (subject.he/she) finds the pig standing in a brand-new hole in exactly the same place, muddy to the eyebrows and completely unrepentant. They look at each other for a long moment. Neither of them mentions it.
